author: Daniel P. Clark
description: Algebraic data types and Haskell pattern syntax for Ruby. Clauses are compiled once into a decision tree by a Rust extension (via Rutie) and checked for exhaustiveness and redundancy, so every logical path is accounted for before the first call.
